enum.description: No interpolation, value of A gets held until B is encountered

enum.name: Linear
enum.description: Straight-line interpolation between A and B (i.e. no ease in/out)

enum.description: Smooth interpolation between A and B, with some control over curve shape

enum.description: Sinusoidal easing (weakest, almost linear but with a slight curvature)

enum.description: Cubic easing with overshoot and settle

enum.description: Exponentially decaying parabolic bounce, like when objects collide

enum.name: Elastic
enum.description: Exponentially decaying sine wave, like an elastic band

properties.description: Method used to map source vertices to destination ones

enum.name: Nearest Edge Vertex
enum.description: Copy from closest vertex of closest edge

enum.description: Copy from interpolated values of vertices from closest point on closest edge

enum.name: Nearest Face Vertex
enum.description: Copy from closest vertex of closest face

enum.name: Nearest Face Interpolated
enum.description: Copy from interpolated values of vertices from closest point on closest face

properties.name: Edge Mapping
properties.description: Method used to map source edges to destination ones

enum.description: Copy from most similar edge (edge which vertices are the closest of destination edge's ones)

enum.name: Nearest Face Edge
enum.description: Copy from closest edge of closest face (using midpoints)

enum.name: Projected Edge Interpolated
enum.description: Interpolate all source edges hit by the projection of destination one along its own normal (from vertices)

properties.name: Face Corner Mapping

enum.name: Nearest Corner and Best Matching Normal
enum.description: Copy from nearest corner which has the best matching normal

enum.name: Nearest Corner of Nearest Face
enum.description: Copy from nearest corner of nearest face

enum.name: Nearest Face Interpolated
enum.description: Copy from interpolated corners of the nearest source face

enum.name: Projected Face Interpolated
enum.description: Copy from interpolated corners of the source face hit by corner normal projection

properties.name: Face Mapping
properties.description: Method used to map source faces to destination ones

enum.name: Nearest Face
enum.description: Copy from nearest face (using center points)

enum.name: Best Normal-Matching
enum.description: Copy from source face which normal is the closest to destination one

enum.description: Interpolate all source polygons intersected by the projection of destination one along its own normal
